simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כָּרָה (H3739) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: כָּרָה (kârâh) means to purchase First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 6 23.

definitions.full: H3739. karah II. [ כָּרָה ] verb get by trade, trade (Late Hebrew כִּירָה act of buying, purchase (so 'in den Küstenländern,' Levy NWB ii. 323 f. ); Arabic let for hire ); — only Qal Imperfect 1singular suffix וָאֶכְּרֶהָ Hosea 3:2 (dagesh forte dirimens, si vera punctat., Ges § 20 . 2, b; but compare We); 3 masculine plural יִכְרוּ Job 40:30; 2 masculine plural תִּכְרוּ Deut 2:6 ; Job 6:27 ; — get by trade, buy , with accusative Hosea 3:2 ; Deut 2:6 ; followed by - עַל trade in, make trade of Job 6:27 ; Job 40:30. III. [ כָּרָה ] verb give a feast (literally perhaps bring (guests), invite ; compare Assyrian karû , bring , kirêtu , feast , kireti iškun , he gave a feast , Dl :HWB 352); — only Qal Imperfect . with accusative of congnate meaning with verb, גְדוֺלָהוַיִּכְרֶה כֵּרָה לָהֶם 2Kin 6:23 and he gave a great feast for them (the context requires this sense, but text dubious, Nö ZMG 1886, 724 , compare Klo).
definitions.rootNote: usually assigned as a primitive root, but probably only a special application of 3738 (through the common idea of planning implied in a bargain);
